description.value: Little Fox Bakehouse is an artisan scratch bakery founded by Red Seal pastry chef Eric Ho, who pivoted from a 13-year engineering career to pursue his passion for baking. Everything is handcrafted on-site using traditional French techniques with real butter — no shortening or margarine — and the menu spans croissants in a wide variety of flavours, mousse cakes, canelés, and more. An espresso bar rounds out the offering for take-out drinks.
